description: A tank with a long gun barrel and a machine gun on its turret rolls through a dusty, dry desert with scrubby bushes and flat-topped hills behind it. Smoke rises in the background and dust is kicked up around its tracks. On the right, several uniformed soldiers in olive fatigues and helmets carry AK-style rifles and walk toward the viewer. On the left, the tail of a transport aircraft opens, and more soldiers are unloading wooden crates and stacking olive ammunition boxes on the sand. A tiny coloured mark sits in the bottom right corner.
